description: This file is a shell script (`run_l1_tests.sh`) used as a test runner for a software project. It automates patch application, environment setup, build, and testing workflows for the project, particularly with emphasis on idempotent patching and ensuring specific revisions of dependencies like ThunderTools.

methods.name: apply_patch_idempotent
methods.description: Apply a patch file to a target directory in a safe, idempotent way without creating .rej files, using dry-run and reverse-dry-run checks.

methods.name: ensure_thundertools_expected_revision
methods.description: Reset ThunderTools repository to a specific git reference (tag or commit), ensuring a clean, matching baseline for applying patches.

methods.name: run_build_and_l1_tests
methods.description: Configure, build, and run the project's L1 tests using CMake and CTest, with optional dependency installation control.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point that orchestrates patch application, revision pinning, build, and testing workflows based on the workspace directory.
